content: Hey love, how was your day? I kept thinking about your smile all afternoon.
Oh, you're so sweet! My day was okay, just the usual work chaos. Yours?
Busy as ever, but I couldn't wait to talk to you. Honestly, you're the highlight of my evenings.
Aw, I feel the same. It's nice to have someone who truly cares.
By the way, I was a bit distracted today. I had a long call from the school. My youngest's registration fee is due this week, and the deadline is tomorrow.
Oh no, is everything okay? That sounds stressful.

It's just a hiccup. I thought I'd have the incoming payment in time, but the funds are held up with my client. I hate even saying this, but would you be able to help me cover the $285 fee? I'd pay you right back as soon as it clears.
That's a lot of money, but I understand how important school is for your kid. How would I send it?
You're amazing, thank you for even considering it. The school's taking payments through Zelle right now. I can send you the account details. Would that work for you?
I've never used Zelle before, but I think my bank app has it. Just send me the info and I'll try.
Perfect. Here's the info: Send to tuitionpayhelp@gmail.com. Could you let me know once you've sent it? I'm so grateful, really.
No problem. Should I put your name in the memo?
Yes, just use my name and 'registration fee.' If you have any issues, let me know. I know it's a lot to ask, but I promise I'll make it up to you.
I trust you. It's just that I've never really done something like this before.
I completely understand. It means so much to me and my little one. I wouldn't ask unless it was truly important. You're a part of our family now.
You're making me blush. I'll try to send it now.
You're incredible. Just let me know if you get any error or need help. I'm here for you, always.
Okay, I'm opening my app. Just double-checking: tuitionpayhelp@gmail.com, right?
Yes, that's correct. Thank you, love. I'll let you know the moment it comes through.
Alright, sending now. I hope this helps your kid get settled in school. You both deserve the best.
